Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

cmgdr 0.99.0

  • Prepared for Bioconductor submission: biocViews, version 0.99.0, a Quarto vignette that runs against the live site.
  • Find datasets and releases from the site’s JSON indexes (cmgd_datasets(), cmgd_releases(), cmgd_release()).
  • List tables, files and studies; download files into a SHA-256-verified cache (cmgd_tables(), cmgd_files(), cmgd_studies(), cmgd_study_files(), cmgd_download()).
  • Read per-study files and build species TreeSummarizedExperiment objects (cmgd_read_study(), cmgd_species_tse()).
  • Read the published sample-metadata tables (cmgd_sample_metadata()), look up samples by run accession (cmgd_find_runs()) and read a release’s provenance (cmgd_provenance()).
  • Attach a release’s DuckLake catalog in DuckDB (cmgd_connect()).
  • HUMAnN gene-family file indexes (cmgd_genefamilies()).

Developed by Sean Davis.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
